title: Revision evidence summary
responsibility: Summarizes a commit’s attached records into coverage and explicit gaps without treating unusable evidence as passing.

inputs.name: revisionSummary.status
inputs.description: Attached record status, validity and problems from history inspection.

inputs.name: revisionSummary.views
inputs.description: Readable record views supplying profile, finish time and comparison base by record id.

outputs.name: revisionSummary
outputs.description: Coverage, gaps and record summaries. No records is unverified; any usable passed record is verified; usable failures yield failed; only unusable records yield invalid. Unreadable metadata is unknown and invalid-record problems are named as gaps.
